title: Tún brand
notes: This is the project's own identity, already public on tun.community and in the pitch artefacts -- not confidential like a company brand plugin, so private is false. It provides only 'tokens' (no 'assets' -- no logo artwork is vendored here yet). Never installed by default: core pins the neutral palette for every build (docs/22-plugin-contract.md), so this plugin is selected explicitly via TUN_PALETTE=plugins/tun/tokens/palette.css. See plugins/tun/README.md for the derivation of all eight slots from the four colours used on the public site, and the WCAG contrast table.
